groups.title: How to stay up-to-date with Vision advances
groups.text: How to stay up-to-date with Vision advances Papers ● arXiv > Computer Science > Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition ● General ML (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) and Vision (CVPR, ECCV) venues Code ● Authors’ GitHub repositories linked in their papers ● paperswithcode.com: browse state-of-the-art datasets/methods for each task Miscellaneous ● Stanford course websites (e.g. CS231n) ● Twitter (academics + industry leaders) ● YouTube theoretical (Two Minute Papers, Yannic Kilcher) and practical (Google Developers, HuggingFace) ● Company/academia technical papers + blogs (Amazon Science, Apple ML, Google AI, Google DeepMind, Microsoft Research, OpenAI)
